title: Register a land title document or plan
text:
Land titles
Land Titles and Surveys in-person service is still paused in Calgary and Edmonton to help us reduce processing times and support modernization of our registry system. Support continues to be available through phone and email.
Overview
Land title documents and plans can be registered at a Land Titles office.
If you are not familiar with land law and real estate transactions, we suggest you get legal advice and help when dealing with property.
Our
Common Documents and Errors
: Recommended Fixes and Best Practices document provides additional information to help you avoid common mistakes and errors when filling out your documents.
Cost
Fees for document and plan registration are listed in the
Tariff of Fees Regulation
and are required at the time of submission.
The
Land Titles and Surveys Common Documents Fee Schedule
lists fees for the most common documents.
Fees can be paid in person by cash, cheque, credit or debit. Cheques must be made payable to the Government of Alberta.
Note: the Fee Schedule will be updated on October 20 to reflect the implementation of the Land Titles Registration Levy.
